name: availability-grid
title: Availability grid
description: Paint the hours you are free: days across, hours down, drag or press to toggle, with a keyboard grid and a summary of the ranges.
docs: value is a list of slot keys: a day (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday), a dash and the start time, "1-09:00" for Monday from nine; onValueChange gets it sorted. days, weekStartsOn, startHour, endHour (the last row ends there) and slotMinutes (15, 20, 30, 60) shape the grid. Drag to paint a rectangle: the cell you start on decides, a chosen cell clears, an empty one fills; a day heading fills or clears its day; on touch a swipe still scrolls the page, and a finger that rests on a cell for a quarter of a second starts painting instead (the page stops scrolling under it and the card gets a ring). One tab stop: arrow keys move, Home, End, Page Up and Down jump, Space or Enter toggles, Shift with the arrows extends a range that Space applies. It is a grid role, each cell named and stated ("Tuesday 09:00 to 09:30, available"), changes announced politely. A summary folds the choice into ranges ("Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00") with hours a week. Chosen cells also carry a check in forced-colours mode. locale, hour12, name, labels.
